purpose: Select the current source evidence for one Source Record across every Sender Installation that observed it, by source ordering rather than arrival order: the newest projection by source modification time, a retraction that supersedes every projection it follows, or an explicit Source Conflict when different content shares the newest time; record that selection against the evidence it was computed from without erasing or rewriting any evidence and without fuzzy or clientRecordId-only merging.

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.description: The Operational Store identity of one Source Record, typically taken from operational-store@3's records awaiting selection.

inputs.name: decided_at
inputs.description: The timezone-aware Portal time recorded with the selection.

inputs.name: source_record
inputs.description: The Source Record read through operational-store@3: its key, every projection and retraction evidence row in delivery order with position, observing installation, cycle, source modification time and projection digest, its evidence head, and its earlier selections; and the selection written back through the same store.

inputs.name: free_space
inputs.description: Free bytes on the store's filesystem, which the store compares with its reserve when recording a selection.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: A deterministic, health-data-free decision computed from the Source Record's evidence alone: a current projection naming one projection evidence row, a current retraction naming one retraction evidence row, or a Source Conflict naming one projection evidence row for each distinct content at the newest source modification time.

outputs.name: reconciliation_result
outputs.description: The decision recorded as an append-only selection at the record's current evidence head, with whether it is unchanged from the record's previous selection; an identical decision at an unchanged head writes nothing.

outputs.name: reconcile_failure
outputs.description: A named refusal or retryable failure that recorded nothing.

observable_effects.name: source-selection-write
observable_effects.description: One append-only reconciled selection committed through operational-store@3 for the Source Record; a refusal, retryable failure, or identical repeat commits nothing.

owns: ordering one Source Record's projections by source modification time, never by arrival order, Sender Installation, or clientRecordId
the rule by which a retraction supersedes the projections delivered before it and is superseded only by a strictly newer projection
treating identical content at the newest time as one assertion and different content at the newest time as an explicit Source Conflict
recording the decision against the evidence head it was computed from, and reporting whether it changed
does_not_own: extracting identities from projection bytes, indexing archived items, or storing evidence and selections
Reconciliation Absence and Abandoned Attempt Evidence, which arrive with the Phase 6 completion units
activating selections into current views, Cutover Targets, Candidate Builds, or Health Summaries
interpreting projections, Processing Jobs, policies, or duplicate grouping across Source Records
scheduling, retrying, or polling for records awaiting selection
